contradictions.why: The route's approach/waypoints/approach_logistics fields all describe reaching Trapper Lake by boat or floatplane to Stehekin and hiking up the Stehekin River Trail from Harlequin Campground, but the itinerary's own day-1 schedule instead starts at the 'Cascade River Road trailhead' and crosses 'Cascade Pass' and 'Pelton Basin' — the entirely different, Marblemount-side corridor.
contradictions.internal_resolution: waypoints, approach, approach_logistics and access.fees (which prices a Stehekin ferry/floatplane) all agree on the Stehekin-side approach; the itinerary's Cascade River Road/Pelton Basin wording is the outlier and matches the OTHER route on this peak (North Couloir)'s approach almost verbatim.

contradictions.internal_resolution: climbing_route (the most detailed, source-specific account) is explicit about the gap; high_point_ft/waypoints appear to assume the summit is reached without documented support.

contradictions.why: The fa field credits Kloke/Simon (1976) with the first ascent, but the route's own beta text credits a different pair (Cairns/Burdo) with the first ascent, and separately describes a Kloke-Simon outing as an earlier (1974), possibly different line rather than this route's FA.
